# Zonorah, Media Neuroscience Lab

> Zonorah is a Media Neuroscience Lab. Its streaming media monitoring system, used in academic and commercial research, is now open to everyone.

Zonorah is a Media Neuroscience Lab. Its streaming media monitoring system records and counts what media broadcast, and is now open to everyone. Research on the brain is done separately and uses these counts.

## Pages

- [Home](https://zonorah.com/): Zonorah is a Media Neuroscience Lab. Its streaming media monitoring system, used in academic and commercial research, is now open to everyone.
- [Method](https://zonorah.com/method/): How Zonorah records, transcribes and counts radio, TV and YouTube, what the numbers cannot tell you, and how to cite them.
- [Research](https://zonorah.com/research/): Two lines of work on broadcast media: open data for science and journalism, and studies on commission for organisations.
- [Zonorah Data](https://zonorah.com/data/): See how many minutes a word got on radio, TV and YouTube, download the table and ask the AI assistant.
- [Sample studies](https://zonorah.com/studies/): Ten PDF reports from one week of radio and TV in September 2026, one per sector. The reports are in Spanish.
- [Privacy](https://zonorah.com/privacy/): What Zonorah stores, what it does not store and how to delete your account. No recordings are kept.
- [Terms and refunds](https://zonorah.com/terms/): The terms of use, billing and refund rules for Zonorah plans. Draft pending legal review.
